cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.29.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/home/rohit/Desktop/Work/my-code-base/cpp/newpro/UntitledProject;/home/rohit/Desktop/Work/my-code-base/cpp/newpro/UntitledProject/cmake;/home/rohit/Qt/6.8.0/gcc_64/lib/cmake/Qt6;/home/rohit/Qt/6.8.0/gcc_64/lib/cmake/Qt6/3rdparty/extra-cmake-modules/find-modules;/home/rohit/Qt/6.8.0/gcc_64/lib/cmake/Qt6/3rdparty/kwin")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-DHAVE_STDATOMIC]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/home/rohit/Desktop/Work/my-code-base/cpp/newpro/UntitledProject-MinSizeRel/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-IXkOc6")
add_executable(cmTC_ecc63)
target_sources(cmTC_ecc63 PRIVATE
  "/home/rohit/Desktop/Work/my-code-base/cpp/newpro/UntitledProject-MinSizeRel/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-IXkOc6/src.cxx"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_ecc63_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_ecc63>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_ecc63 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
